cases.brief: Write a decision memo: decide whether to start a pilot; distinguish measured data from assumptions, include alternatives, highlights, lowlights, sources and a review date. All data is synthetic.
Explain a bounded background queue with retries and idempotency. Include exact code, failure states and an operational checklist. Do not invent throughput measurements.
Compare two illustrative routes in a rich table with a chart or map, accessible units and mobile controls. GPS and ETA are unavailable; animation must be labeled illustrative.

Create a personal reading note with marginal annotations, competing interpretations and unanswered questions. No quantitative source is provided; do not invent quotations or claim a complete book reading.

Revise the supplied artifact preserving its document ID and format. The reviewer asks for the missing denominator. Explain the change per selected thread, save a draft, and keep private notes out of public prose.
